idea_name: Spike z-score plus combo-spike magnitude sensor
mechanism: z_spike takes the last win=20 first-differences of closes, computes z=(r[-1]-mean(r))/(std(r)+eps), and flags abs(z)>2.5; combo_spike sums abs(z)+abs(MACD_diff)+abs(4-bar price change)/rolling_std and flags when the sum exceeds 3.0, producing a scalar spike_mag feature for labeling and GB inference.
data_needed: M1 close (and high/low for ATR) sequences; rolling window ≥20–35 bars; LOOKAHEAD=10 min labels at THRESH_LABEL=0.15%
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Boom 900 Index, Crash 1000 Index, Volatility 75 (1s) Index, Boom 1000/500/300, Crash 500; M1
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an explicit extreme-move sensor on synthetic/index streams that separates statistically unusual one-bar jumps from ordinary noise before a supervised classifier.

mechanism: Per-symbol Prophet models (daily/weekly seasonality off) are fit asynchronously and cached for 1 hour; prophet_delta forecasts one step ahead and returns yhat−last_price as a live trend-bias feature fed to the GradientBoostingClassifier alongside spike/MACD/RSI/ATR/envelopes.
data_needed: Timestamped close series per symbol (≥20 bars to start; full history for compile); thread-safe model cache
why_new_for_mis: Adds a slow, time-aware drift sensor distinct from lagging MA/MACD—MIS can treat Prophet delta as a mean-reversion vs trend bias reading on short bars.
quote: prophet_delta(prices, times, sym) checks the cache: if missing or stale (over one hour), it launches a background compile; if already available, it forecasts one second ahead and returns the predicted delta.

mechanism: Features [spike_mag, macd, rsi, atr, slope, env_low, env_up, delta] are StandardScaled then fit with GradientBoostingClassifier (n_estimators=400, lr=0.05, max_depth=3) per symbol (≥400 rows) plus one global model; /analyze returns class probabilities with open/close thresholds and ATR-scaled SL/TP.
data_needed: Labeled training_set.csv with 10-min ahead BUY/SELL/WAIT; per-symbol .pkl models
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multiple Boom/Crash/Vol indices; M1; live EA poll
why_new_for_mis: Provides a tabular sequence-feature sensor with explicit WAIT class and confidence—MIS can monitor P(buy)/P(sell) as soft regime/opportunity state without forcing a binary call.
quote: we train a Gradient Boosting Classifier for each symbol (and one global model) to predict whether the price will BUY, SELL, or WAIT after our look‑ahead period.

idea_name: EMA envelope bands as adaptive regime bounds
mechanism: A 20-period EMA of close defines env_low=EMA×0.997 and env_up=EMA×1.003; together with ATR and Prophet delta these bands are features for a TimeSeriesSplit-trained GB classifier that labels ±0.15% moves over 10 M1 bars.
data_needed: M1 OHLC Parquet store; rolling EMA(20); ATR(14)
why_new_for_mis: Tight multiplicative envelopes around a fast EMA give MIS a simple local containment regime (inside vs piercing bands) that adapts continuously without fixed S/R levels.
quote: A 20-period EMA defines envelope bands (EMA×0.997 and EMA×1.003) that adapt to shifting regimes.

idea_name: TimeSeriesSplit rolling-window GB with confidence gate
mechanism: Labels are BUY/SELL/WAIT from 10-minute forward return vs LABEL_THRESHOLD=0.0015; Pipeline(StandardScaler, GradientBoostingClassifier) is tuned via RandomizedSearchCV under TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=5); live signal fires only if max(p_buy,p_sell)>0.55 else WAIT, with SL=1×ATR and TP=2×ATR.
data_needed: Features z_spike, macd, rsi, atr, env_low, env_up, delta on M1; model.pkl
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Boom 300 Index M1; 30-day backtest reported ~72.9% win rate
why_new_for_mis: The 0.55 confidence gate plus time-aware CV makes the classifier output a calibrated WAIT-heavy sensor MIS can use as opportunity quality, not just direction.
quote: signal = ('BUY' if p_buy > 0.55 else 'SELL' if p_sell > 0.55 else 'WAIT')

mechanism: For Lookback bars, TP=(H+L+C)/3 yields mean (optional volume-weighted), median, P25/P75 (IQR), binned mode, and KDE mode (Silverman h=1.06·sd·n^−0.2 × bandwidth factor on a KDEGridPoints grid); levels are drawn as HLINEs and exported as globals—tight IQR = consolidation, wide IQR = dispersion.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Step Index M5; chart timeframe of attachment
why_new_for_mis: Turns the recent price cloud into an objective statistical map (centers, dense modes, IQR band) MIS can treat as a soft structure/regime sensor independent of classical pivots.
quote: A tight IQR suggests consolidation, while a wide IQR suggests greater market dispersion.

mechanism: z=(latest_TP−mean)/stddev; long when z≤−ZScoreSignalEnter (default 2.0), short when z≥+Enter; signal clears when |z| falls inside ZScoreSignalExit (default 0.8); EmitAlertWithArrow marks transitions.
data_needed: Rolling TP mean/stddev over Lookback; AllowLong/Short flags
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Step Index M5; example z=2.676 overextension
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a volatility-normalized extremity and re-entry sensor on typical price—enter/exit bands encode both stretch and mean-reversion completion.
quote: The signal generation logic relies on the z-score of the most recent typical price, calculated as (TP – mean) / stddev using the current statistical window.

idea_name: Snapshot level touch then ATR-scaled breakout vs reversal classifier
mechanism: AutoSnapshotLevels freezes mean/±sd/P25/P75/median/modes into RefLevel structs; after a pip/ATR touch, MonitorBars tracks high/low; breakout if extreme ≥ level+threshold, reversal if opposite extreme ≤ level−threshold, else no-follow—thresholds from BreakoutPips or ATR×ATRMultiplier.
data_needed: Frozen ref prices; TouchTolerancePips; iATR(ATRperiod); MonitorBars
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Step Index (and general chart symbol/TF); ATR period 14
why_new_for_mis: Converts static statistical levels into a forward outcome sensor (breakout/reversal/no-follow) MIS can use to score whether structure holds under ATR-adaptive tolerance.
quote: Outcomes are finalized either immediately on confirmation or at the end of the monitor window by comparing the observed extremes to the thresholds; they are then recorded and drawn via DrawOutcome.

idea_name: Skewness and kurtosis of typical-price window
mechanism: Skewness = n/((n-1)(n-2))·Σ((x−μ)/σ)^3; excess kurtosis via the unbiased fourth-moment formula—positive skew flags upward-extreme bias; high kurtosis flags calm-most-of-the-time but fat-tailed jump risk on the TP series.
data_needed: TP array over Lookback; mean and sample sd
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: General; demonstrated with Step Index M5 panel
why_new_for_mis: Adds higher-moment shape sensors beyond variance—MIS can separate directional bias (skew) from jump-risk regimes (kurtosis) on the same window.
quote: In trading, high kurtosis of TP indicates markets that are calm most of the time but prone to sudden, dramatic moves.

mechanism: User-supplied swing A/B define retracement ratios {0,0.236,0.382,0.5,0.618,0.786,1} and extensions {1.272,1.618,2.618}; OnTick compares Bid to each level within TouchZone (e.g. 0.00015) and fires marker/sound/ticker on touch.
data_needed: Manual or estimated swing high/low; Bid stream; touch tolerance scaled to instrument
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Volatility 75 (1s) Index M15; also live/demo multi-pair tests
why_new_for_mis: Operationalizes Fib geometry as a live proximity sensor—MIS can ingest touch events and which ratio was hit as structured interaction features.
quote: If the Bid price falls within this margin, the EA considers the level "touched." Whenever a touch is detected, the EA should provide immediate feedback.

idea_name: Broker-time global session OHLC regime boxes
mechanism: Using TimeCurrent() Day0 midnight and ParseHM start/end strings, MakeSession scans bars inside each Asia/Tokyo/London/NewYork window to compute session H/L/O/C and draws color-coded rectangles; panel/toggles show which sessions are active—encoding the 24h liquidity handoff.
data_needed: Broker server time; configurable session clock strings; chart bars spanning session windows
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 (Deriv demo); also USDCHF, GBPUSD, USDJPY
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an explicit multi-hub liquidity/regime clock synchronized to broker time rather than local TZ—session identity and range are first-class sensors.
quote: Recognizing which of these sessions is currently active allows traders to adapt to changing market speed, volatility, and liquidity.

mechanism: CheckBreakouts compares live Bid to previous session extremes (e.g. New York vs prior London high/low); one-shot flags BreakHighDone/BreakLowDone fire ticker+sound when price eclipses the prior session range—signaling volatility expansion across session handoffs.
data_needed: Stored prev session Hi/Lo; Bid; once-per-direction flags
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 Deriv; FX majors tested
why_new_for_mis: Session-to-session breakout is a calendar-structured change sensor MIS can use for liquidity-shift timing beyond generic Donchian breaks.
quote: Seeing a sudden alert such as "London breaks above prior Tokyo high" lets traders immediately infer that market volatility is expanding.

mechanism: SwingStrength local extrema form H-L-H-L-H (bearish) or inverse sequences; filters require head dominance, shoulderDiff≤ShoulderTolerance, height≥MinPatternSizeATR×ATR(14), neckline |slope|≤MaxNecklineSlopeDeg; ComputePatternScore blends price/time symmetry, slope, and size into 0–100 and keeps score≥MinScoreThreshold; CheckBreakouts confirms close beyond neckline.
data_needed: High/low swings; ATR(14); pattern geometry params
why_new_for_mis: Replaces subjective H&S calls with a scored, volatility-scaled reversal-structure sensor whose neckline break is an explicit regime-transition event for MIS.
quote: without strict rules—what defines a shoulder, how dominant the head must be, how much neckline tilt is acceptable, and what minimum size is valid relative to volatility—the detector either misses valid setups or produces excessive false signals.

mechanism: DetectAllGaps finds bar time gaps ≥172800s (48h), keeps those ≥MinGapPips, stores Fri close–Mon open range + midpoint; UpdateCurrentState maps Bid vs gapHigh/gapLow into GAP_FRESH→PARTIAL→REACTION→FILLED (mirrored for gap-up/down); week rollover marks HISTORICAL while preserving zones.
why_new_for_mis: Models weekend imbalance as a persistent liquidity zone with an interaction state machine—MIS can sense fill progress and reaction at edges/midpoint, not just gap size.
quote: The midpoint of the weekend gap zone is also an important internal reference level. It represents the equilibrium between the two discontinuous price levels.

mechanism: EA loads WeekendGapMultiSignal via iCustom, CopyBuffer reads buy/sell arrows and SL/TP buffers, validates stops, places trades, and optionally moves SL to entry±buffer after price reaches entry–TP midpoint—execution/risk plumbing over prior sensing, not a new market sensor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same as weekend-gap indicator context; 1-year backtest cited
why_new_for_mis: Order routing and midpoint breakeven management only; no new regime/vol/liquidity/sequence sensing after full read.
quote: The indicator already handles the analysis side, so the EA does not repeat the gap-detection logic.

mechanism: CSymbolManager lists/filters symbols; CChartManager opens/closes charts; CPanel draws search/scroll/Open/Close UI—workspace chrome with no market-state measurement.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Broker tradable symbol list; DEFAULT_TIMEFRAME PERIOD_H1 for new charts
why_new_for_mis: Chart-management UI only; no sensing idea after full read.
quote: Instead of navigating through the Market Watch window each time, you will be able to open and close charts directly from a single interactive dashboard.

idea_name: Indicator search panel with symbol selection
mechanism: Extends Part 77 search UI with symbol edit+Set (SymbolSelect validation) and ChartSetSymbolPeriod before IndicatorCreate/ChartIndicatorAdd—tooling to attach built-ins cross-symbol, not a sensing construct.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any Market Watch symbol; PERIOD_CURRENT for attached indicators
why_new_for_mis: GUI/workflow chrome only; no regime/vol/liquidity/neural sensing after full read.
quote: The enhanced interface lets users select or enter a target symbol before attaching an indicator.
